newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hoyts loss due to restructuring.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hoyts loss due to restructuring.

text.p: The A$78.09 million annual net loss reported by Hoyts Cinemas Group was due to large restructuring charges, a corporate source told Reuters.

The source, who was involved in the company's float last month, said the prospectus did not forecast net earnings for 1995/96. He said, however, that profit before interest and tax result was in line with the prospectus at about A$49.3 million.

The company's largest shareholder is U.S. investment bank Hellman and Friedman with 47.5 percent, followed by management and directors with 22.5 percent and Lend Lease Corp with 9.6 percent. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
